name: Maintenance Tunnel
narrativeOnEnter: A cramped, forgotten maintenance tunnel. Cobwebs and dust. But there — at the far end — a hatch. This is a way out that nobody knows about.

hotspots.label: Hatch Control Panel — Exit
hotspots.lockedMessage: The hatch requires an authorised ID card to override. Find one.

action.text:
Scratched into the wall:

'IF FOUND — HATCH CODE SAME AS ENTRY.
TOLD YOU WE NEEDED A SECOND EXIT.
— K'

Below it, a small symbol that matches something in the lab.

A jacket hung on a nail. A coffee mug, long cold. A battered notebook.

The notebook is open to the last written page:

'Couldn't get them out in time. Triggered the lockdown myself to stop the spread. There might be a way through the tunnel. If you're reading this, you found it.

Get out. Tell someone. The data is in the server logs.

— K'

CLASSIFIED — ARCADIA RESEARCH

Project HELIOS — Phase 3 Status Report.

Biological agent containment breach confirmed: Level-4 laboratory wing, 02:14.

Facility lockdown authorised by Director Vance.

Note: DO NOT transmit externally. DO NOT contact regulatory agencies. Internal resolution authorised.

All personnel losses to be recorded as 'workplace incident'.

— Signed, Director Vance

A facility map, partly faded.

All nine wings are labelled in printed ink. The maintenance tunnel you're standing in isn't on it — but someone has drawn it in by hand, in different ink. A dotted line traces from the tunnel to a point marked 'HATCH — EXTERNAL ACCESS'.

This exit wasn't in the blueprints. K put it there.
